# Purpose
This generated header defines the metric metadata for the `bundle` metrics group used by the metrics system. It assigns fixed offsets, names, types, descriptions, and converter settings for counters, gauges, and a histogram, so the application can register and expose each metric in a consistent way. The file also defines submetric offsets for `bundle_errors`, which separates error categories such as `protobuf`, `transport`, `timeout`, `no_fee_info`, and `ssl_alloc`.
